voltage_levels.voltage_note: Transmission grid voltage is being raised from 220 to 400 kV. The regional grid currently at 70 kV will be replaced over time by a 130 kV grid — significantly increased transfer capacity.

local_grid_outlook: Characterized by an increase in the number of customers and, over time, increased consumption. Connection of micro-production (primarily rooftop solar on single- and multi-family houses) has reduced peak demand on sunny summer days, but consumption need remains because this production does not follow the daily consumption pattern.
regional_grid_outlook: The regional grid currently at 70 kV will be replaced over time by a 130 kV grid, significantly increasing transfer capacity in the regional grid.
transmission_grid_relations: Rapid rebuilding of both transmission and regional grid is underway in Stockholm to handle increased consumption. Transmission grid voltage is being raised from 220 kV to 400 kV.
production_outlook: Some dispatchable production in the form of CHP, but a large deficit of dispatchable production connected to local and regional grid means that a large share of capacity demand must be supplied from the transmission grid.
consumption_outlook: Increased consumption is the driver for transmission and regional grid rebuilding. Customer count is growing over time.
narrative_note: Vattenfall Eldistribution's Stockholm area overlaps geographically with Ellevio's subareas 7 (Stockholm) and 8 (Lidingö). Vattenfall is the upstream grid owner for several of Ellevio's interconnection points (Älvsjö, Järva, Koltorp, Kyrkviken, Högberga). Cell mapping must handle the overlap.
